characters.name: Isaac
characters.canonical_appearance: A young Ethiopian anime boy with warm medium-dark brown skin, a slim lanky build, expressive dark brown eyes, and medium-length black freeform dreadlocks that fan outward in a slightly messy style. He wears a loose cream V-neck T-shirt with traditional Ethiopian-inspired geometric trim on the collar and sleeves, dark gray straight-leg pants, and simple black shoes.

characters.name: Gertie
characters.appearance: Young adult female, average build, long straight auburn hair, green eyes, often seen in colorful, eclectic clothing with a signature red scarf.
